subject: CloudBridge + Redwood marketplace demo — pre-demo handoff checkpoint
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudbridge.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie.park@gcpsi.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@aws-partner.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: CloudBridge x Redwood marketplace demo — proposed windows and SI availability

Hi team — thanks again for the quick coordination. We are aiming to get the marketplace co-sell demo scheduled for the week of Apr 11 so CloudBridge can present the joint integration and Redwood can highlight the listing/playbook. Two proposed live demo windows (PT):

- Tue Apr 11, 09:00–09:45 PT (preferred for CB execs)
- Wed Apr 12, 08:00–08:45 PT (preferred for AWS team)

We will need the SI (GCPSI) in the call for a short technical segment and to answer integration questions. Can you confirm: (1) which of the two windows works for Redwood, (2) SI run-through availability (we’d like a 30‑45m rehearsal the day prior), and (3) whether you need any compliance/marketing assets from our side ahead of time?

Attaching a first-pass agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf). I’ll follow up with speaker names once I have them.

Thanks — Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudbridge.io>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudBridge x Redwood marketplace demo — proposed windows and SI availability

Thanks Amit — nice to meet you over email.

We can do either window but want to align on what success looks like and logistics:
- Redwood preference: Wed Apr 12, 08:00–08:45 PT (gives our product folks more time the week of)
- SI rehearsal: Sat Apr 10 08:30–09:15 PT (we prefer a short technical dry run 24–48h before; can be adjusted)
- Please confirm timezone for any external participants (looks like AWS prefers early morning).

Vanessa, Karthik — looping you both to handle calendar invites, runbook handoff, and marketplace listing sync. Marissa, can you own SI ops with Jamie?

I’ve attached an updated agenda (demo-agenda-v3.pdf) that folds in a 10m compliance slide per Sara’s earlier ask. Amit/Sara — please send speaker bios and any brand assets to the Drive link in the related links so we can include them on the registration page.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Attachments: demo-agenda-v3.pdf

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@aws-partner.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie.park@gcpsi.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudBridge x Redwood marketplace demo — proposed windows and SI availability

Appreciate the fast turnaround. AWS can attend Wed Apr 12 08:00 PT. One ask from our side: include a brief slide (3–4 bullets) on customer data flow and tenancy (we need it for pre-approval of the marketplace listing). Also, legal has asked for the runbook and proof of logging for the demo—Jamie's team can confirm the exact artifact later.

Jamie — can GCPSI make the rehearsal on Apr 10 08:30 PT? If not, propose alternatives.

Amit — sending speaker bios now; attaching Sara-Liu_bio.docx in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Sara
Partner Programs, AWS Marketplace

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@aws-partner.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudbridge.io>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie.park@gcpsi.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudBridge x Redwood marketplace demo — rehearsal logistics and AV plan

On Wed, Apr 4, 2028 at 11:12 AM Sara Liu <sara.liu@aws-partner.com> wrote:
> Appreciate the fast turnaround. AWS can attend Wed Apr 12 08:00 PT. One ask from our side: include a brief slide (3–4 bullets) on customer data flow and tenancy (we need it for pre-approval of the marketplace listing). Also, legal has asked for the runbook and proof of logging for the demo—Jamie's team can confirm the exact artifact later.

All — Karthik here from Redwood Ops. Quick logistics:
- Confirmed: Live demo Wed Apr 12, 08:00–08:45 PT (we’ll block 08:00–09:00 on Redwood calendars to allow debrief)
- Rehearsal: Tue Apr 11, 08:30–09:15 PT (shifting rehearsal to Tue to give AWS/Legal time after rehearsal to review artifacts)
- AV: please join the Zoom 15 minutes early for AV check (link in related_links).
- Runbook: I’ve attached runbook-rehearsal.xlsx (staging checklist, roles, failover script). Marissa — can you coordinate the SI tasks inside the runbook and confirm who from GCPSI will own the logging proof?

If legal needs a short, anonymized logging snapshot, Jamie, can your team deliver by EOD Wed Apr 11? We can redact customer identifiers.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook-rehearsal.xlsx

All — finalizing invites and assets. Confirming the timeline below and sending calendar invites now:

- Tue Apr 11, 08:30–09:15 PT — SI rehearsal (GCPSI) — Zoom (AV test 08:15 PT)
- Wed Apr 12, 08:00–08:45 PT — Live marketplace co-sell demo — Zoom (AV test 07:45 PT)

Attachments included: demo-agenda-v3.pdf, runbook-rehearsal.xlsx, speaker-bios.docx. I also added a short appendix with the compliance bullets requested by AWS to slide 6.

Next actions: Amit — add final CloudBridge exec names to the Drive by EOD today. Jamie — confirm who from GCPSI will provide the anonymized logging snapshot to legal by Wed EOD. Marissa — please confirm the rehearsal host and handoff owner inside the runbook.

I’ll post the calendar invites from the Redwood calendar; please accept so we can lock the registration page and marketplace listing entry.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Partner Programs — Redwood Inference
